protocol.search_data: validation stage only: candidates/features from training histories, labels = validation film; test targets never read during the search
protocol.search_split: validation-stage users split at random (seed 0): 4832 fit users, 1208 tune users
protocol.objective: NDCG@10 of the re-ordered candidates on the tune users (missing validation film = miss), ranker trained on the fit users with the repo routine (10% of fit users with a positive for early stopping, patience 50)
protocol.sampler: TPE (seed 0); trial 0 = default recipe; no pruning; search features from SASRec seed 0, LightGBM seed 0
protocol.final: ranker trained on all validation-stage users (repo routine), scored once on the test targets; seed s = SASRec seed s features + LightGBM seed s
protocol.bootstrap: 1000 paired resamples of users, tuned minus default

validation_check.note: tune-user NDCG@10, ranker trained on fit users, SASRec seed 0 features, LightGBM seeds [0, 1, 2]
